old_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a melting popsicle resting on a patterned paper towel. The popsicle is striped with yellow, red, and brown colors, suggesting it might be a fruit-flavored treat. As the video progresses, the ice begins to melt, creating a pool of water around the base of the popsicle. The liquid spreads slightly, forming a small puddle that gradually grows larger. The paper towel underneath shows signs of moisture, with some areas becoming darker and more saturated. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, focusing solely on the popsicle and its immediate surroundings, providing a clear and detailed observation of the melting process.

caption: The video captures a multi-colored ice pop lying horizontally on a white embossed paper towel, its flat wooden stick protruding to the right. The body shows bands of dark purple, yellow, orange-red, and bright yellow, coated in frost and condensation. A wet, dyed halo already surrounds it, reddish-purple liquid wicked leftward and yellowish liquid seeping rightward into the towel's pressed circular pattern. As the clip runs, this meltwater stain creeps marginally further outward, its fringed edges growing a touch more defined against the drier paper. The pop holds its position and overall shape throughout, showing no translation or dramatic collapse. A slight reframe nudges the object a little larger in the frame while the melting and wicking continue steadily.
